name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.123.0 — `/spec:mocks` gains a WALK state between WIREFRAMES and SIGNOFF: each declared journey is walked once by a fresh-context critic that reads its screens in declared order, enters their gray empty/loading/error states as branches, and may report only six flow breaks (no-path-back, no-path-forward, dead-end-state, missing-data, ambiguous-control, unrecoverable-error), never naming, hierarchy, density, or a "consider…" suggestion. Findings are mock-scope notes of `kind: "walk"`, cited to a screen and a declared state; `--mark journey-walked --journey <j>` refuses while one is still open, and `--reopen walk:<j>` (plus the journey/shapes cascade) invalidates it. `spec/agents/design-critic.md` is rewritten in place as this one journey-walk critic, replacing the four-heuristic per-screen pass it also ran at `/spec:sketch`'s Critique step; the mocks stage cannot be signed off on a journey nobody walked. 7.122.0 — replay.js's --apply now runs a host-declared post-apply reconcile hook (replay.afterApply) between applying the mutation patch and committing it, staging exactly the declared paths so the mutation commit carries the same derived-artifact reconciliation a real build commit carries, excluding those paths from the canonical patch, and recording a setup-failed outcome on any hook refusal; size-ratchet.js gains --reconcile as the one-shot form of that reconciliation on the main tree. 7.121.0 — `/spec:mocks` retires the THEME state: `deriveState` no longer derives THEME, the driver's authoring/gate/reopen surfaces drop direction-composed, theme-picked, stop open theme and --reopen theme, and status.json stops carrying theme/directions/marks.themePicked — the chain is now SEED -> SHAPES -> KIT -> WIREFRAMES -> SIGNOFF -> APPROVED, with the theme picked by /spec:sketch after sign-off instead. Both doctrine homes (spec/doctrine/mocks.md, spec/commands/mocks.md) stop describing the retired state, and render-gate.js's --mocks comment is repointed at the new theme-pick timing.
